claim: Patchline verifies that its verdict depends on migration semantics rather than surface syntax by re-running analysis under semantic-preserving perturbations — identifier renames, reformatting, and added comments — and confirming the verdict is unchanged, while a genuine semantic change still flips it. The worker classifies each perturbed variant, measures the stability rate across semantic-preserving perturbations, and checks that a semantics-altering perturbation that removes the backfill produces the opposite verdict. The gate proves full stability under cosmetic perturbations and correct sensitivity to the semantic one.
